-- codem-inventory: add these to codem-inventory/config/itemlist.lua (same format as QBCore shared items).
-- If your codem-inventory version reads items from your framework instead, use qb-inventory.txt (QBCore / Qbox)
-- or esx.sql (ESX).
-- Copy the images from install/images/ to codem-inventory/html/itemimages/.
-- Note: the codem adapter runs phones in 'character' mode (one number per character); see
-- bridge/inventory/codem-inventory.lua to enable per-item phones.

['tml_flipphone']  = { name = 'tml_flipphone',  label = 'Flip Phone', weight = 150, type = 'item', image = 'tml_flipphone.png',  unique = true, useable = true, shouldClose = true, description = 'A retro flip phone.' },
['tml_smartphone'] = { name = 'tml_smartphone', label = 'Smartphone', weight = 190, type = 'item', image = 'tml_smartphone.png', unique = true, useable = true, shouldClose = true, description = 'A modern smartphone.' },

-- Optional: only if you give a smartphone design its own item in Config.Designs (config.lua).

files.core_inventory.txt:
-- core_inventory reads item definitions from your framework:
--   QBCore / Qbox: add the lines from qb-inventory.txt to qb-core/shared/items.lua
--   ESX:           run esx.sql
-- Then copy the images from install/images/ to core_inventory/html/img/.
-- Keep phones non-stacking (unique) where your core_inventory config lets you set it per item: every phone has its
-- own number.
-- Note: the core_inventory adapter runs phones in 'character' mode (one number per character); see
-- bridge/inventory/core_inventory.lua to enable per-item phones.
files.esx.sql:
-- ESX: for inventories that read ESX's items table (core_inventory, codem-inventory on ESX).
-- With ox_inventory on ESX, use ox_inventory.txt instead.
-- ESX's own default inventory has no adapter: there the phone runs without items (everyone has one, opened with the
-- command or keybind), so this file isn't needed.
INSERT INTO `items` (`name`, `label`, `weight`, `rare`, `can_remove`) VALUES
  ('tml_flipphone', 'Flip Phone', 1, 0, 1),
  ('tml_smartphone', 'Smartphone', 1, 0, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `label` = VALUES(`label`);

-- Optional: only if you give a smartphone design its own item in Config.Designs (config.lua).

files.ox_inventory.txt:
-- ox_inventory: add these to ox_inventory/data/items.lua (inside the returned table).
-- `stack = false` matters: every phone has its own number, so phones must never stack.
-- Copy the images from install/images/ to ox_inventory/web/images/ (tml_flipphone.png, tml_smartphone.png).

['tml_flipphone'] = {
  label = 'Flip Phone',
  weight = 150,
  stack = false,
  close = true,
  consume = 0,
  description = 'A retro flip phone.',
  server = { export = 'tml_phone.use_item' },
},

['tml_smartphone'] = {
  label = 'Smartphone',
  weight = 190,
  stack = false,
  close = true,
  consume = 0,
  description = 'A modern smartphone.',
  server = { export = 'tml_phone.use_item' },
},
